definitions.explanation: A common white butterfly with small black spots on its wings. Its green caterpillars feed on cabbage and related plants.

examples.japanese: モンシロチョウ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいる→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: A cabbage white is fluttering about.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧モンシロチョウ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幼虫|ようちゅう}→幼虫：16411_youchuu⟧がいた。
examples.english: There were cabbage white caterpillars on the cabbage leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{菜|な}の{花|はな}→菜の花：14042_nanohana⟧{畑|ばたけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧モンシロチョウ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひらひら→ひらひら：04814_hirahira⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧。
examples.english: In spring, cabbage whites flutter over the fields of rapeseed blossoms.

notes:
From ⟦{紋|もん}→紋：13863_mon⟧ (crest, spot) + ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ (white) + ⟦{蝶|ちょう}→蝶：04288_chou⟧ (butterfly), for the black spots on its white wings. It is the most familiar butterfly in Japan, and elementary school pupils raise its caterpillars in science class.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{蝶|ちょう}→蝶：04288_chou⟧: butterfly
- アゲハチョウ: swallowtail butterfly
- {青虫|あおむし}: green caterpillar
